name: Get Customer and Accounts
query: query GetCustomer($customerId: ID!) { customer(id: $customerId) { name accounts { iban balance } } }

name: Get Account and Transactions
query: query GetAccount($iban: String!) { account(iban: $iban) { iban transactions { amount } } }

name: Federation Feature: Fragment Spread
description: Verify fragment spread support with named fragments
query: query GetCustomerWithFragment($id: ID!) { customer(id: $id) { ...CustomerFields } } fragment CustomerFields on Customer { name accounts { iban balance } }

name: Federation Feature: Inline Fragments
query: query GetCustomerInline($customerId: ID!) { customer(id: $customerId) { name ... on Customer { accounts { iban balance } } } }

name: Federation Feature: Nested Fragments
description: Verify nested fragment expansion (fragments referencing other fragments)
query: query NestedFragments($id: ID!) { customer(id: $id) { ...CustomerWithAccounts } } fragment CustomerWithAccounts on Customer { ...BasicCustomer accounts { ...AccountInfo } } fragment BasicCustomer on Customer { name } fragment AccountInfo on Account { iban balance }

name: Federation v2: @requires - Risk Score Computation
description: Verify that @requires automatically fetches balance field for riskScore calculation
query: query AccountRisk($iban: String!) { account(iban: $iban) { iban riskScore } }

name: Federation v2: @inaccessible - Should block access to SSN
description: Verify that @inaccessible field cannot be queried
query: query CustomerSSN($id: ID!) { customer(id: $id) { id name ssn } }

name: Federation v2: @tag - Fields with tags should work normally
description: Verify that @tag fields can be queried (tags are metadata)
query: query CustomerTier($customerId: ID!) { customer(id: $customerId) { id name tier } }

name: Variables: Multiple Variables with Different Types
description: Verify multiple variables can be used together with different types
query: query MultipleVars($customerId: ID!, $iban: String!) { customer(id: $customerId) { id name } account(iban: $iban) { iban balance } }

name: Variables: Optional Variable Override
description: Verify that variable values work correctly
query: query CustomerWithDefault($id: ID!) { customer(id: $id) { id name tier } }

name: @interfaceObject - Auditable Interface for Customer
description: Verify @interfaceObject support for Auditable interface on Customer entity
query: query GetCustomerAudit($id: ID!) { customer(id: $id) { id auditId createdAt modifiedAt modifiedBy } }

name: @interfaceObject - Auditable Interface for Account
description: Verify @interfaceObject support for Auditable interface on Account entity
query: query GetAccountAudit($iban: String!) { account(iban: $iban) { iban auditId createdAt modifiedAt modifiedBy } }

name: Audit Log Query with Mixed Types
description: Verify auditLog query returns multiple Auditable implementations across different entity types
query: query AuditLogMixed { auditLog { auditId createdAt modifiedAt modifiedBy } }

name: @override - EU Customer Tier Override
description: Verify @override directive for Customer.tier field in EU region
query: query GetEUCustomerTier($id: ID!) { customer(id: $id) { id tier } }

name: @override - GDPR Consent Field
description: Verify @override directive supports GDPR consent field in EU customer extension
query: query GetGDPRConsent($id: ID!) { customer(id: $id) { id gdprConsent } }

name: Union - FinancialActivity with Transactions
description: Verify union type FinancialActivity can return Transaction objects
query: query GetActivityWithTransaction($customerId: ID!) { customerActivity(customerId: $customerId) { ... on Transaction { id } } }

name: Union - FinancialActivity with AccountOpening
description: Verify union type FinancialActivity can return AccountOpening objects
query: query GetActivityWithAccountOpening($customerId: ID!) { customerActivity(customerId: $customerId) { ... on AccountOpening { id customerId accountType timestamp } } }

name: Union - Mixed Financial Activity Events
description: Verify union type FinancialActivity with __typename to distinguish mixed event types
query: query GetMixedActivity($customerId: ID!) { customerActivity(customerId: $customerId) { __typename ... on Transaction { id amount } ... on TierUpgrade { id oldTier newTier } ... on AccountOpening { id accountType } } }

name: Edge Case: Multiple @key Fields with Federated Queries
description: Verify customer can be resolved via multiple @key definitions (id and auditId)
query: query GetCustomerByMultipleKeys($id: ID!) { customer(id: $id) { id name tier auditId } }

name: Edge Case: Nested Auditable with Fragment Spread
description: Verify nested Auditable fields work with fragment spreads across federation boundaries
query: query GetAccountWithAuditFragment($iban: String!) { account(iban: $iban) { ...AccountAuditFields } } fragment AccountAuditFields on Account { iban balance auditId createdAt modifiedAt }
